aboutGame.title: What is Fisch?
paragraphs: Fisch is a Roblox fishing adventure focused on exploration, collecting and progression. Cast your line, reel in different catches, build your collection and improve your fishing equipment as you explore an expanding world.

Fish can appear with a huge range of variations, while new locations, equipment and limited-time content give players more reasons to explore. Progression revolves around learning fishing mechanics, discovering better catches and developing increasingly capable gear.

modules.name: Fisch Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the core fishing loop in Fisch step by step: casting, attracting a bite, controlling the fishing bar and completing your first catch.

highlights.detail: Hold down the input to cast your bobber into the water.
Wait for a bite; you can shake your rod while waiting to attract fish faster.
After a bite, hold or click to control the white bar and follow the blue line as closely as possible.
Keep the fishing interaction going until the progress bar at the bottom fills, then the fish is reeled in.

modules.name: Fisch Map and Locations
modules.description: Key Fisch locations are tied to rod progression, merchants, Bestiary completion and access to advanced areas.

highlights.label: Moosewood
highlights.detail: The starter rod merchant stand sits around coordinates 465, 150, 230 and sells early rods including Training, Plastic, Carbon, Long, Fast and Lucky.

highlights.label: Roslit Bay
highlights.detail: The Blacksmith area sits around -1515, 140, 765 and sells Steady, Fortune and Rapid rods.

highlights.label: Vertigo
highlights.detail: Enter Vertigo by jumping into a Strange Whirlpool marked by a vertical pillar of light; the Nocturnal Rod and Aurora Rod are associated with this area.

highlights.label: Desolate Deep
highlights.detail: A secret merchant area around -990, -245, -2695 includes the Reinforced Rod and Trident Rod.

highlights.label: The Arch
highlights.detail: Located near the Statue of Sovereignty around 980, 130, -1230; the Destiny Rod requires more than 70% Bestiary completion.

highlights.label: Northern Summit
highlights.detail: Contains several rod locations, including the Arctic Rod near the base-camp merchant and the Avalanche Rod near the third camp.

modules.name: Fisch Rod of the Depths Guide
modules.description: The Rod of the Depths is tied to Vertigo Bestiary completion, special Enchant Relics, The Depths Key and a maze inside The Depths.

highlights.detail: Prepare more than C$750,000, a Hexed Enchant Relic, an Abyssal Enchant Relic, 100% Vertigo Bestiary completion including Isonade, and The Depths Key.
If needed, obtain Enchant Relics and use the Moosewood Appraiser until you have both Hexed and Abyssal variants.
Enter Vertigo through a Strange Whirlpool, complete its Bestiary, and obtain The Depths Key by fishing in Vertigo or the Strange Whirlpool.
Inside The Depths, place the Hexed Enchant Relic on the altar at the top of the waterfall and the Abyssal Enchant Relic on the altar below the giant statue.
Complete the maze below the statue to reach the Rod of the Depths, which costs C$750,000.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Fisch.

items.question: What is Fisch?
items.answer: Fisch is a free-to-play fishing adventure on Roblox by Fisching, released on October 5, 2024. You cast, reel and collect across an expanding ocean world with 400,000+ possible fish variations, islands to explore and rods to upgrade. The game has passed 4.8 billion visits.

items.question: How do I redeem Fisch codes?
items.answer: Open Fisch on Roblox and enter a working code in the game's codes menu to claim rewards such as the Scarlet Skin, Carbon Bobber or submarine building parts. The Fisch Wiki Codes page tracks every currently active code and its reward.

items.question: What is the best rod in Fisch?
items.answer: Every angler starts with the free Flimsy Rod at Moosewood and works up through Training, Plastic and Carbon Rods to endgame picks like the Kings Rod (C$120,000) and the Rod of the Depths (C$750,000). The Fisch Rod Tier List compares the most popular rods by tier.

items.question: Where do I find rare fish in Fisch?
items.answer: Rare Fisch catches depend on location, weather, season and bait. For example, the Exotic Blue Whale appears during Clear Summer weather with Shrimp bait, while Scylla hides in Mariana's Veil and prefers Shark Head bait. The Bestiary page lists the conditions for every entry.

items.question: Is Fisch free to play?
items.answer: Yes, Fisch is free to play on Roblox and runs on servers of up to 20 players. You only need a Roblox account to start fishing, and all of the game's rods, fish and locations can be reached through normal play.
